user_query: I want to surprise my friends with personalized email invitations for a special event. Could you suggest the top email marketing services that offer customizable templates and easy-to-use platforms? It would be great if you could also provide guidelines for creating engaging email content to maximize the event's attendance.

TaskList.description: Research and list the top email marketing services that offer customizable templates and user-friendly platforms.
Provide guidelines for creating engaging email content aimed at maximizing attendance for the event.
Compile the information from steps 1 and 2 into a cohesive report to present to the user.
